roadmap.name: Devops-engineering
roadmap.description: Lộ trình trở thành DevOps Engineer - người kết nối giữa Development và Operations, xây dựng pipeline CI/CD, quản lý infrastructure, containers, automation và monitoring. Bắt đầu từ nền tảng Linux/networking, phát triển kỹ năng scripting, containers, IaC, cloud, đến SRE và security practices.

stages.name: Foundation
stages.description: Nắm vững nền tảng Linux, networking và các khái niệm cơ bản của IT infrastructure.

skills.name: Linux Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: File operations: ls, cd, pwd, mkdir, rm, cp, mv, touch, cat, less, more
File permissions: chmod, chown, chgrp, octal permissions
User management: useradd, usermod, userdel, passwd, groups
Process management: ps, top, htop, kill, killall, nice, nohup
Disk management: df, du, mount, fdisk, lsblk
Shell redirection: stdin, stdout, stderr, pipes
System monitoring: uptime, free, vmstat, iostat

nextSkill.name: Networking Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững kiến thức networking cơ bản.

skills.name: Networking Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: IP addressing: IPv4, IPv6, subnetting, CIDR notation
DNS: records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS), DNS resolution process
HTTP/HTTPS: methods, status codes, headers, TLS/SSL handshake
Load balancing concepts: round-robin, least connections
Proxy servers: forward proxy, reverse proxy
Firewall concepts: packet filtering, stateful inspection
Network troubleshooting: ping, traceroute, nslookup, dig, netstat, ss, curl
SSL/TLS certificates: generation, installation, Let's Encrypt

nextSkill.name: Computer Science Basics
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững kiến thức CS cơ bản cho DevOps.

skills.name: Computer Science Basics
whatYouWillLearn: Cấu trúc dữ liệu cơ bản: Array, Stack, Queue, Hash Table
Big O Notation: O(1), O(log n), O(n)
Git version control: init, add, commit, branch, merge, push, pull
Code review basics: pull requests, merge requests
Command line proficiency: navigation, file operations, processes
Text editors: vim, nano, VS Code
Environment variables: PATH, HOME, custom variables
Shell scripting basics: variables, conditionals, loops

nextSkill.name: Bash Scripting
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu học scripting để automation.

stages.name: Scripting & Programming
stages.description: Phát triển kỹ năng scripting để automation và tooling.

skills.name: Bash Scripting
whatYouWillLearn: Shell script structure: shebang, variables, comments
Loops: for, while, until, break, continue
Script best practices: debugging, logging, documentation

nextSkill.name: Python for DevOps
nextSkill.description: Học Python cho automation và tooling nâng cao.

skills.name: Python for DevOps
whatYouWillLearn: File I/O: reading, writing, working with files
Modules và packages: import, pip, virtual environments
Data structures: lists, dictionaries, sets, tuples
Subprocess: running shell commands from Python

nextSkill.name: Go (Optional)
nextSkill.description: Học Go cho DevOps tooling (optional nhưng recommended).

skills.name: Go (Optional)
whatYouWillLearn: When to use Go vs Python
Go trong DevOps tools: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform

nextSkill.name: CI/CD Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu học CI/CD pipelines.

stages.name: CI/CD & Automation
stages.description: Xây dựng và quản lý pipelines CI/CD để tự động hóa build, test, deploy.

skills.name: CI/CD Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: CI/CD concepts: Continuous Integration, Delivery, Deployment
CI/CD pipeline stages: build, test, deploy
Pipeline design: triggers, stages, steps, artifacts
Deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, rolling, recreate
Secret management: credentials, API keys, certificates
Branching strategies: GitFlow, GitHub Flow, trunk-based
Pipeline as Code: defining pipelines in version control
Quality gates: linting, testing, security scanning
Release management: versioning, changelogs, release notes

nextSkill.name: GitHub Actions
nextSkill.description: Học GitHub Actions cho CI/CD.

skills.name: GitHub Actions
whatYouWillLearn: GitHub Actions overview: workflows, jobs, steps, triggers
Workflow syntax: name, on, jobs, steps
Jobs và steps: runs-on, uses, run, with, env
Matrix builds: testing across multiple OS/versions
GitHub Actions examples: Node.js, Python, Docker
GitHub Actions best practices: security, organization

nextSkill.name: Jenkins
nextSkill.description: Học Jenkins cho CI/CD (alternative).

skills.name: Jenkins
whatYouWillLearn: Jenkins UI: dashboard, jobs, builds, console output
Pipeline syntax: stages, steps, post, agent
Jenkins best practices: pipeline organization, caching

nextSkill.name: GitLab CI/CD
nextSkill.description: Học GitLab CI/CD (alternative).

skills.name: GitLab CI/CD
whatYouWillLearn: Jobs và stages: defining pipeline structure
Docker executor: using containers for jobs
GitLab Container Registry: storing Docker images
Security scanning: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning

nextSkill.name: Docker
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu học containerization với Docker.

stages.name: Containerization
stages.description: Container hóa ứng dụng với Docker và orchestration với Kubernetes.

skills.name: Docker
whatYouWillLearn: Docker fundamentals: containers, images, registries, layers
Dockerfile: instructions (FROM, RUN, COPY, ADD, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, EXPOSE, WORKDIR, ENV)
Building images: docker build, tags, multi-stage builds
Running containers: docker run, ports, volumes, networks
Docker Compose configuration: services, build, ports, volumes, env_file
Docker volumes: named volumes, bind mounts, anonymous volumes
Docker networking: bridge, host, overlay, none
Docker security: non-root user, minimal images, secrets
Docker registry: Docker Hub, private registries, AWS ECR
Docker debugging: logs, exec, inspect, top, stats
Docker optimization: .dockerignore, layer caching, image size
Docker for databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
Docker Swarm basics: clustering, service management

nextSkill.name: Kubernetes
nextSkill.description: Học Kubernetes cho container orchestration.

skills.name: Kubernetes
whatYouWillLearn: Kubernetes architecture: control plane, nodes, components
Kubernetes objects: Pods, ReplicaSets, Deployments, Services
Pods: lifecycle, containers, init containers, sidecars
Ingress: routing, TLS termination, path-based routing
DaemonSets: running pods on all nodes
Resource limits: CPU, memory requests and limits
Health checks: liveness probe, readiness probe, startup probe
Kubernetes networking: CNI, service mesh basics

nextSkill.name: Infrastructure as Code
nextSkill.description: Học cách quản lý infrastructure bằng code.

stages.name: Infrastructure as Code
stages.description: Quản lý infrastructure bằng code với Terraform, Ansible và CloudFormation.

skills.name: Terraform
whatYouWillLearn: Infrastructure as Code concepts: declarative vs imperative
Terraform basics: providers, resources, data sources
Terraform workflow: init, plan, apply, destroy
State management: local state, remote state (S3, Terraform Cloud)
Terraform import: bringing existing resources under management
Terraform best practices: directory structure, naming, state
AWS provider: EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, IAM

nextSkill.name: Ansible
nextSkill.description: Học Ansible cho configuration management.

skills.name: Ansible
whatYouWillLearn: Ansible architecture: control node, managed nodes, inventory
Ad-hoc commands: running tasks on managed nodes
Playbooks: YAML format, tasks, handlers, variables
Modules: common modules (yum/apt, service, copy, template, user)
Variables: facts, playbook vars, inventory vars, extra vars
Templates: Jinja2 templating, variables in templates
Ansible best practices: task organization, idempotency
Ansible vs Terraform: differences, when to use which
Ansible for configuration management: installing packages, managing services
Ansible for provisioning: working with Terraform

nextSkill.name: Cloud Platform (AWS)
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu học cloud platform.

stages.name: Cloud Platforms
stages.description: Làm việc với các cloud platform: AWS, GCP, Azure.

skills.name: AWS Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: AWS overview: regions, availability zones, edge locations
IAM: users, groups, roles, policies, best practices
EC2: instances, security groups, key pairs, elastic IP, AMIs
VPC: subnets, route tables, internet gateway, NAT gateway, NACLs
S3: buckets, objects, policies, lifecycle, versioning, replication
RDS: managed databases, Multi-AZ, read replicas, backups
ELB: Application Load Balancer, Network Load Balancer
Auto Scaling Groups: scaling policies, lifecycle hooks
API Gateway: REST API, HTTP API, authorizers
ECS: container service, Fargate, task definitions
AWS CLI: command-line interface, common commands
AWS cost management: pricing, Free Tier, Cost Explorer

nextSkill.name: GCP Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Học Google Cloud Platform.

skills.name: GCP Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: IAM: users, service accounts, roles, policies
Compute Engine: VMs, instance groups, templates
VPC: subnets, firewall rules, routes, Cloud NAT
Cloud Storage: buckets, classes, lifecycle, versioning
Cloud SQL: managed databases, replicas, backups
GKE: managed Kubernetes, node pools, autopilot
Cloud Logging: log explorer, sinks, exports
GCP vs AWS: comparison, migration considerations

nextSkill.name: Azure Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Học Microsoft Azure.

skills.name: Azure Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: Azure overview: regions, availability zones, resource groups
Azure AD: users, groups, service principals, managed identity
Virtual Machines: sizes, images, disks, availability sets
Virtual Networks: subnets, NSGs, peering, load balancers
Storage Accounts: blobs, files, tables, queues
Azure SQL: managed databases, elastic pools
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): clusters, node pools
Azure Monitor: metrics, alerts, log analytics
Azure Key Vault: secrets, keys, certificates
Azure cost management: pricing, budgets, reservations

nextSkill.name: Monitoring & Observability
nextSkill.description: Học cách monitor và observe systems.

stages.name: Monitoring & Observability
stages.description: Xây dựng hệ thống monitoring, logging và observability.

skills.name: Monitoring Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: SLA, SLO, SLI:定义, measurement, commitments
Error budgets: managing reliability vs velocity
Incident management: detection, response, resolution, postmortem
Monitoring architecture: agents, collectors, storage, visualization
Monitoring tools overview: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog
Monitoring best practices: what to monitor, alert fatigue

nextSkill.name: Prometheus & Grafana
nextSkill.description: Học monitoring stack phổ biến nhất.

skills.name: Prometheus & Grafana
whatYouWillLearn: Prometheus overview: pull-based metrics, time-series database
Metrics types: counter, gauge, histogram, summary
Prometheus exporters: node_exporter, blackbox_exporter, custom exporters
Grafana overview: data sources, dashboards, panels
Grafana visualization: graphs, tables, heatmaps, singlestats
Grafana alerting: unified alerting, notification channels

nextSkill.name: ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana)
nextSkill.description: Học logging stack ELK.

skills.name: ELK Stack
whatYouWillLearn: ELK Stack overview: Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Beats
Elasticsearch architecture: clusters, nodes, shards, replicas
Application logs: structured logging, correlation IDs
ELK on Kubernetes: Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK)
ELK best practices: index management, query optimization

nextSkill.name: Security & SRE
nextSkill.description: Học security practices và SRE principles.

stages.name: Security & SRE
stages.description: Bảo mật infrastructure và áp dụng SRE principles.

skills.name: DevSecOps & Security
whatYouWillLearn: DevSecOps shift-left: security early in pipeline
OWASP Top 10: web application security risks
SCA: Software Composition Analysis, dependency scanning
Container security: image scanning, runtime protection
Secret management: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager
Infrastructure security: least privilege, defense in depth
Network security: firewalls, VPN, zero trust
Compliance: SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS basics
Security automation: automated patching, vulnerability scanning
Incident response: preparation, detection, containment, recovery
Security monitoring: SIEM, log analysis, anomaly detection
Security best practices: hardening, access control

nextSkill.name: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
nextSkill.description: Áp dụng SRE principles vào operations.

skills.name: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
whatYouWillLearn: SRE principles: software engineering approach to operations
SLA, SLO, SLI: definition, measurement, error budgets
Release engineering: canary, blue-green, feature flags
SRE tools: monitoring, alerting, incident management
SRE practices: runbooks, playbooks, game days
SRE vs traditional ops: differences, benefits
Building SRE culture: mindset, practices, organization

nextSkill.name: Advanced Topics & Career
nextSkill.description: Chủ đề nâng cao và phát triển sự nghiệp.

stages.name: Advanced Topics & Career
stages.description: Chủ đề nâng cao và phát triển sự nghiệp DevOps Engineer.

skills.name: Advanced DevOps Practices
whatYouWillLearn: Service Mesh: Istio, Linkerd, traffic management
Chaos engineering: Litmus, Chaos Monkey, fault injection
FinOps: cloud cost optimization, resource tagging
Edge computing: CDN, edge functions, IoT
Serverless operations: Lambda, Cloud Functions management
DevOps maturity model: assessing and improving

nextSkill.name: Certifications
nextSkill.description: Chuẩn bị các chứng chỉ DevOps.

skills.name: DevOps Certifications
whatYouWillLearn: AWS certifications: Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer
GCP certifications: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
Certification study strategies: resources, practice exams
Building DevOps portfolio: projects, case studies
DevOps communities: DevOps Days, conferences, meetups
Career paths: DevOps Engineer → Senior → Staff → Principal → Platform Lead
DevOps roles: SRE, Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer
Salary negotiation: market rates, negotiation tactics
Continuous learning: staying current with trends, tools

nextSkill.name: Career Ready!
nextSkill.description: Hoàn thành lộ trình DevOps Engineer và sẵn sàng cho sự nghiệp.
